title: Two threads, one picture: the worker, the page, and diffing the view
question: A question from a meeting with Cyrus: how do our performance fixes so far compare with a more principled approach, where the worker builds a virtual DOM of each view, diffs it against the last one, and sends the page only the patches? Did we already do some of this, and how far does the idea go? Can a worker even build real DOM nodes? And is it expensive to keep several representations of the same DOM?
